  • Method Details

    • deadCollision

      public static boolean deadCollision(Player player, int rows, int columns, List<Player> enemies)
      Checks if there is a dead collision. A dead collision for a snake is a collision with its body, with board boarders or with other snakes.
      Parameters:
      player - the player to check
      rows - the number of rows on the game board
      columns - the number of columns on the game board
      enemies - other players on the board
      Returns:
      true if there is a dead collision, false otherwise
